thread:
maya (AE): Heads-up: ForgeCloud bumped the POC to CISO review. Primary asks: written data residency confirmation, a brief on our cross-region failover behavior, and confirmation we can limit first-quarter overage exposure. They've requested an exec-level touchpoint next week.
rachel (Solutions Eng): On data residency we can guarantee region confinement (eu-central-1). For failover we usually do automatic fallback to CPU-backed variant in-region; can document perf delta. Do they want an architecture diagram?
dylan (CS): CISO also asked for network allowlist + audit log retention details. I have the customer's SAML doc; two open items were key rotation frequency and cert management.
maya (AE): Great. They explicitly asked for a cost protection ask: cap overages for month 1-3. Can we propose a fixed cap tied to token usage?
tom (Legal): We can do a short-term amendment. Need exact cap value and whether it covers tokens only or includes storage/infra. Also need to check whether mutual indemnity request is negotiable.
anita (Product): For the failover brief: propose one-liner: "Regional availability SLA 99.9% with automatic fallback to an in-region CPU-compatible model when GPU resources are degraded; telemetry surfaced to customer console." I'll add expected p50/p95 deltas.
rachel (Solutions Eng): I'll sketch a small diagram and drop into the drive. Also note: fallback may increase token cost due to CPU inference; call that out.
maya (AE): I'm pushing the customer for the cap number now. If they give a dollar cap today we can move fast.
calendar-bot: Proposed meeting: "ForgeCloud C-level Briefing" Tue 10:00 UTC - tentative invite to maya, rachel, dylan, tom, anita
dylan (CS): Sending the partial SAML export and our answers for key rotation. Also flagged the audit logs retention (90 days by default) 10: details in drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/forgecloud-poc
tom (Legal): Draft amendment snippet I can start from: ```
- Trial overage cap: Provider agrees to limit Customer's monthly overage charges for token-based inference to $X,000 for months 1-3. Overage defined as charges attributable to token consumption above the included quota.
- Cap applies to token charges only.
```
Please confirm $X value.
maya (AE): Customer replied: prefers $7,500/mo cap on token overage for first 3 months. They want that in writing before CRO attends.
tom (Legal): I can populate the $7,500 and send an internal redline by EOD tomorrow. If Product approves the SLA phrasing we can attach the one-sheet to the amendment.
anita (Product): Approved to use the phrasing above. I'll add a bullet about expected perf variance: "p50 +25ms; p95 +120ms on fallback" and a short table of model variants.
rachel (Solutions Eng): Uploading diagram + one-sheet now. Link: https://drive.internal/redwood/forgecloud-poc/diagrams/overview.png
maya (AE): Next steps tracker: 1) Customer confirm cap (CONFIRMED: $7.5k/mo) 2) Tom -> amendment draft with cap (ETA: tomorrow EOD) 3) Rachel -> diagram + one-sheet (DONE) 4) Anita -> SLA perf note + model table (ETA: tomorrow AM) 5) Dylan -> SSO key rotation answer + logs excerpt (DONE).
tom (Legal): I'll ping when draft is ready. Quick Q: does the cap survive if customer scales included tokens mid-trial? Need guidance whether cap recalculates on commit change.
anita (Product): Let's keep cap tied to the initial included quota at POC start. If customer extends commit, we'll revisit the cap in the amendment. Add that clause.
maya (AE): If amendment + slides are ready by Tue 08:00 UTC I can lock CRO for Tue 10. If legal runs late we may need VP-sales to stand in.
calendar-bot: Meeting confirmed: "ForgeCloud C-level Briefing" Tue 10:00 UTC - invite accepted by maya, rachel, dylan, anita; tom tentative
maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll post a final pre-brief checklist in this thread once Tom shares the redline. :thumbsup:
